points: At the start of Yehoyakim's reign, Yirmiyahu stands in the courtyard of the Bais Hamikdash and warns: if you don't listen, this House will be like Shiloh.
The Kohanim, the false prophets and the people grab him and want to kill him. The judges set up a proper trial.
The judges and the people say he spoke in Hashem's name, like Michah HaMorashti in Chizkiyahu's time. The other side points to Uriyahu ben Shemayahu, whom Yehoyakim chased down in Egypt and killed.
Achikam ben Shafan saves Yirmiyahu from the people.
Rabbi Binyamin Lau notes the people keep flip-flopping, kill him, don't kill him, kill him. The lesson: don't just follow the crowd or even the leaders. Think for yourself.
